newsitem.title: USA: Ohio Gov signs bill to package school bonds, tax.
newsitem.headline: Ohio Gov signs bill to package school bonds, tax.

text.p: Ohio Gov. George Voinovich on Thursday signed into law a bill allowing school districts to package tax and bond questions together on the ballot.
The new law, which has immediate effect, lets schools combine in one ballot measure proposed property tax levies for capital projects and operating expenses, bond issues and income taxes.
Previously, schools had to submit separate ballot questions for each, resulting sometimes in voter approval to build a new school but not for the funds to operate that school.
